tools.name: get_capital_fit_offer
tools.description: Read the current $49 bounded capital-research offer. Creates no charge and does not make a financing decision.

tools.name: prepare_capital_fit_checkout
tools.description: After the human explicitly agrees to pay $49, create the bounded capital-research case and secure Polar checkout. Checkout creation is not payment proof.

tools.name: get_capital_case_status
tools.description: Read the case state, independently verify Polar payment, and run the bounded paid research when the machine-commerce token and verified payment authorize it.
